### Unmet Expectations
Author: Dawn Mast
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/unmet-expectations-encouragement-caf-may-16-2019.html
Passage: Exodus 5:2
Points:
- Personal frustration often erupts when we expect others to agree with us or act righteously.
- Moses and Aaron met harsh resistance from Pharaoh because he openly admitted he did not know God.
- Expecting people who do not know the Lord to act with Christian character leads only to hurt and disappointment.
- Understanding this reality allows believers to release their anger, set wise boundaries, and pray for those who oppose them.

### Who Is the Lord?
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-apr-22-2009-11602589.html
Passage: Exodus 5:2
Points:
- Pharaoh’s dismissive inquiry reflects a question still asked by many people today.
- Finite human minds cannot fully comprehend the infinite nature, holiness, or triune reality of God.
- A God small enough to be completely understood by human minds would be too small to meet our deepest needs.
- Believers are empowered by the Holy Spirit to know God personally and make Him known to the world.
